name: CharXiv
intro: 图表理解在多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）应用于分析科学论文或财务报告等实际任务中扮演着关键角色。现有数据集常侧重于过度简化和同质化的图表，导致对模型进展的评估过于乐观。CharXiv是一个全面的评估套件，包含2,323个来自arXiv论文的自然、具有挑战性和多样化的图表。它包括描述性问题和推理问题，所有图表和问题均由人类专家精心挑选、整理和验证。
org: Princeton Language and Intelligence (PLI), Princeton University, University of Wisconsin, Madison, T
intro_en: Chart understanding plays a crucial role in applying multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to real-world tasks such as analyzing scientific papers or financial reports. Existing datasets often focus on overly simplified and homogeneous charts, leading to overly optimistic assessments of model progress. CharXiv is a comprehensive evaluation suite containing 2,323 natural, challenging, and diverse charts sourced from arXiv papers. It includes both descriptive and reasoning questions, with all charts and questions carefully selected, curated, and validated by human experts.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.18521. The paper downloads arXiv preprints from eight academic subjects from January 2020 to September 2023, extracts and re-renders figures, then applies a four-step chart selection pipeline: SigLIP similarity prefiltering, graduate-student manual selection for visual diversity, pairwise-similarity deduplication, and removal of blurry or unclearly labeled charts, yielding 2,323 charts. It builds two question families: four descriptive questions per chart using 19 templates across extraction, enumeration, pattern recognition, counting, and compositionality, with one intentionally unanswerable descriptive question, plus one manually crafted reasoning question per chart with a definite answer. CharXiv validates answers for automatic grading, evaluates 13 open-source and 11 proprietary MLLMs, and compares them with in-house human participants under the same instructions, including the reported 80.5 percent human reasoning baseline.
